sn35.53:1.1: PAÑÑĀSAKO DUTIYO Sāvatthi || la || Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Kathan nu kho bhante jānato katham passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjatīti || ||
sn35.53:2.1: Cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu aniccato jānato passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjatīti || || Rūpe aniccato jānato passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjati || || Cakkhuviññāṇam || || Cakkhusamphassaṃ || || Yam pidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi aniccato jānato passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjati || || Sotaṃ || || Ghānaṃ || || Jivhaṃ || || Kāyaṃ || || Manam aniccato jānato passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjati || || Dhamme || || Manoviññāṇaṃ || || Manosamphassaṃ || || Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukham vā || tam pi aniccato jānato passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjati || || Evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evam passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjatīti || ||
